connector.name: Daxoom
connector.registryDescription: Owner-verified local business data for AI agents: profiles, hours, prices, with provenance.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.daxoom.com over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.daxoom. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: Daxoom API key (dxm_ prefix). Free Developer tier (3,000 queries/month) at https://daxoom.com/developer.
